title: Vignette 2026-11-21: an MCP agent must locate and cross-reference each thread, and find events of a kind and data from similar times

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Make sure that an Mcp agent can easily locate and cross reference each of the threads. 

A query should be able to find types of events. Check for emails, events and any data from similar times.

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-11-21; recorded verbatim (the meaningful sentences only; a sentence naming the private repository's user is left out). Said about a private repository used by a non-technical user through a connector; it set the requirement the auto-index request rests on.
